summary: DT Cloud Star Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, disclosed in an Item 8.01 8-K that its sponsor, DT Cloud Star Management Limited, deposited a $75,000 extension payment into the trust account on September 21, 2026, extending the deadline to complete an initial business combination by one month to September 26, 2026. No target, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed; the filing concerns only the monthly trust extension mechanics. Watch the abbreviated runway to September 26, 2026, subsequent extension deposits, and liquidation risk if no deal is announced.
